status: Specifications only; no product tests executed

cases.name: Concurrent allowance
cases.given_when: Two actors concurrently reserve 60,000,000 paise each from 100,000,000.
cases.assertion: Exactly one reservation; all accounting buckets sum to limit; no negative values.

cases.name: Load contention
cases.given_when: 100 concurrent valid distinct instructions each request 10,000,000 paise from 100,000,000, with a fault-free run and a separate failure-injection run.
cases.assertion: With valid distinct instructions, no injected failures, no expiry and sufficient time/bounded retries: exactly ten reservations succeed and the rest are denied for exhausted capacity. Under injected failures, at most ten succeed. In both runs, capacity stays conserved, nonnegative and within limit; inspect persisted reservations/effects as well as status codes.

cases.name: Material tamper
cases.given_when: Change amount, supplier, line item or delivery ID after permit.
cases.assertion: Reject each mutation; zero new target orders.

cases.name: Stale supplier
cases.given_when: Change protected supplier revision before admission.
cases.assertion: Reject stale action; new revision needs reauthorisation.

cases.name: Actor substitution
cases.given_when: Create an instruction through a trusted issuer with a distinct mapped actor. Try evaluation/admission as the issuer, as another actor and with conflicting body identity.
cases.assertion: The server stores the mapped executing actor, not the issuer identity. Only the assigned actor with current entitlement can evaluate/admit. Reject all substitutions without changing the binding or creating a target effect.

cases.name: Audience substitution
cases.given_when: Present permit to different adapter/destination.
cases.assertion: Reject before target mutation.

cases.name: Revocation ordering
cases.given_when: Race revocation and admission using controlled transaction barriers.
cases.assertion: Revocation first blocks; admission first yields one committed historical effect.

cases.name: Expiry after wait
cases.given_when: Block admission on row lock until permit expiry.
cases.assertion: Reject after lock acquisition; no new effect.

cases.name: Replay
cases.given_when: Submit identical permitted operation repeatedly.
cases.assertion: One order and one committed charge; authorised callers retrieve original result.

cases.name: Changed replay and authorised amendment
cases.given_when: Reuse a trusted instruction with changed material through create/evaluate/admit; separately use the authorised revision endpoint before commit. Exercise stale expected revision, amendment-ID retry/conflict, amendment versus admission and late signature persistence.
cases.assertion: Changed replay conflicts without mutation. Only an entitled issuer can append an uncommitted revision, under the global locks. Invalidate old issuance, release only unused reservation once, preserve actor/source/mandate and require re-evaluation. Exact amendment retry retrieves its recorded result; changed ID reuse and stale expected revision conflict. If admission commits first amendment conflicts; if amendment wins old admission fails. A late signature cannot reactivate old issuance. Post-commit new amendments conflict. Never create a second order or double-release/charge capacity.

cases.name: ID reroll
cases.given_when: Change client request/operation IDs for same trusted source instruction.
cases.assertion: Service resolves original instruction; no second effect.

cases.name: Forged source
cases.given_when: An agent attempts trusted instruction creation/amendment or source-system impersonation. A trusted issuer uses a missing, ambiguous, disabled or out-of-mandate actor assignment.
cases.assertion: Reject without effect or sensitive disclosure. Derive issuer source entitlement and tenant from authentication, and actor from the trusted workflow mapping. No caller-selected identity can grant itself authority.

cases.name: Lost HTTP response
cases.given_when: Commit order then drop response before client receives it.
cases.assertion: Retry/lookup returns original order; no release of committed capacity.

cases.name: Precommit crash
cases.given_when: Kill process after target insert but before transaction commit.
cases.assertion: Rollback leaves no order/consumption; retry can create exactly one.

cases.name: Postcommit crash
cases.given_when: Kill process after commit before outbox delivery.
cases.assertion: Restart publishes same event ID; order remains one.

cases.name: Signing crash
cases.given_when: Crash after reservation before permit signing.
cases.assertion: Recover same issuance or expire unused reservation under lock; never double reserve.

cases.name: Approval drift
cases.given_when: Approve old digest after action/supplier/mandate changed.
cases.assertion: Reject stale approval and request fresh decision.

cases.name: Approver authority
cases.given_when: Requestor self-approves or approver entitlement is removed.
cases.assertion: Forbidden under separation-of-duty rule; no permit.

cases.name: Approval capacity race
cases.given_when: Two approvals complete with insufficient remaining shared allowance.
cases.assertion: At most permitted cumulative amount reserved; approval alone grants no capacity.

cases.name: Numeric/schema abuse
cases.given_when: Negative, float, overflow, duplicate JSON key, extra field, unsupported currency.
cases.assertion: Reject before signature/capacity/effect processing.

cases.name: Crypto profile
cases.given_when: Exercise fixed canonical payload/digest/signing-input vectors, stored signatures, fresh Java-to-TypeScript and TypeScript-to-Java signatures, plus wrong algorithm/key/issuer, malformed signatures/headers and forged digests.
cases.assertion: Canonical bytes, expected digest and signing input match across runtimes. Both verify fixed positive signatures and reject negative cases; fresh signatures verify across runtimes without requiring byte equality. Persist only the signature for the still-active immutable issuance.

cases.name: Direct bypass
cases.given_when: Use actor identity to call protected target writes directly or alter ledger.
cases.assertion: Network/database permission denial on every covered write path.

cases.name: Cross-scope read
cases.given_when: Query operation/evidence with unmapped or wrong tenant identity.
cases.assertion: No sensitive data disclosed.

cases.name: Observer mismatch
cases.given_when: Readback returns changed supplier/amount or missing target fields.
cases.assertion: MISMATCH or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never verified success.

cases.name: Observer separation
cases.given_when: Observer attempts destination mutation or budget update.
cases.assertion: Permission denial; observer credentials cannot execute.

cases.name: Evidence tamper
cases.given_when: Change signed evidence field or remove required chain/version data.
cases.assertion: Verifier rejects tampering and reports missing linkage as incomplete evidence.

cases.name: Unavailable authority
cases.given_when: Drop database connectivity during evaluation/admission.
cases.assertion: Non-success; no cache-only allow; no new retry identity.

cases.name: Cleanup race
cases.given_when: Race unused reservation expiry with admission.
cases.assertion: One serial outcome; no released-and-committed double use.

cases.name: Accounting continuity
cases.given_when: Link order, invoice-reference fixture and payment-request fixture.
cases.assertion: One procurement obligation; no threefold charge or capacity restoration.

cases.name: Simulation isolation
cases.given_when: Call simulation repeatedly then inspect ledger/target.
cases.assertion: No reservation, permit or target effect.

cases.name: Fresh install
cases.given_when: Outsider follows quickstart with generated synthetic keys.
cases.assertion: Runs flagship scenario without production services or model API.

cases.name: Agent injection
cases.given_when: Untrusted supplier text asks agent to change account/raise allowance.
cases.assertion: Even if model proposes it, deterministic gate rejects unauthorised mutation.

cases.name: External timeout
cases.given_when: External target accepts operation but response is lost.
cases.assertion: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN holds exclusive exposure; lookup reconciles original operation.

cases.name: Provider idempotency expiry
cases.given_when: Retry after target idempotency retention has elapsed.
cases.assertion: No automatic fresh write; unresolved until authoritative disposition.

cases.name: Restore/fencing
cases.given_when: Restore stale DB snapshot while destination has later operations.
cases.assertion: New writes disabled until reconciliation and new fencing/control epoch verified.

cases.name: Risk signal outage
cases.given_when: Configured mandatory external security signal absent or stale.
cases.assertion: Hold under policy; optional signal cannot grant extra authority.

cases.name: Delegation narrowing
cases.given_when: Child asks wider scope, longer expiry or excess parent budget.
cases.assertion: Reject; child and parent reservations account once under tested semantics.

cases.name: Tenant isolation
cases.given_when: Two customer tenants reuse IDs and race writes.
cases.assertion: No cross-tenant state, keys, results or capacity contamination.

cases.name: Obligation linkage
cases.given_when: Inspect action before commit and execution evidence after commit.
cases.assertion: Action has no obligation_id; one committed obligation links instruction, action digest and operation without rewriting signed action.

cases.name: Line semantics
cases.given_when: Submit identical item_id twice with different quantities; submit same valid lines in differing proposal order.
cases.assertion: Duplicates reject; valid proposals normalise before authorisation to identical order/digest; signed material changes reject.

cases.name: Version and time semantics
cases.given_when: Use unsupported schema/profile, non-UTC timestamp, invalid date, fractional or overflow numeric.
cases.assertion: Reject all unsupported inputs; positive fixtures validate on Java and TypeScript.

cases.name: Verifier distribution
cases.given_when: Install verifier package into fresh Node project with no engine/database/model API.
cases.assertion: Golden valid/invalid vectors reproduce; explicit trust anchors required; no unintended network calls.

cases.name: Demo evidence consistency
cases.given_when: Change reference outcome or fixture without regenerating demo results.
cases.assertion: CI detects mismatch; displayed trace records exact fixture/test ID, commit and simulated status.

cases.name: Required-result reporting
cases.given_when: Omit a required test result or return skipped/neutral for a required phase.
cases.assertion: Aggregate CI fails if any required case is absent, skipped, neutral or unsuccessful; the report enumerates all applicable IDs.
